items.title: 1972-11-07 Two.Hour.Afternoon.Block
items.description:
This is one of the prizes of my collection... a rare two-hour afternoon block from Nov 7, 1972 (Election Day) on Washington's WRC-TV with original commercials, in excellent condition.

The block party starts with an uber-rare episode of the soap opera Somerset, a 30 minute spin off of Another World.
